 List of early voting locations in Dallas County for the Nov. 3 midterm election 
 Election Day is Tuesday, Nov. 3. The polls will be open from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., and if you're in line by 7 p.m., you will be allowed to vote. 
 By Frank Heinz • 
 Published 2 hours ago • 
 Updated 1 hour ago 
 BOOKMARKER 
 NBc 5 News 
 2026 Midterm Election
 When is Early Voting? Early voting begins Monday, Oct. 19 and runs through Friday, Oct. 30. A list of voting locations is here for Collin County , Dallas County , Denton County , Tarrant County 
 When is Election Day?  Tuesday, Nov. 3, is Election Day and polling locations will be open from 7 a.m. until 7 p.m. You can vote if you're in line by 7 p.m. on Election Day.
 Federal races: ( U.S. Senate , U.S. House )
 State races: ( Governor , Lt. Governor , Attorney General, Comptroller, GLO Commissioner, Agriculture Commissioner, Railroad Commissioner , State Board of Education, Texas Senate, Texas House)
 County races: (Collin, Dallas, Denton, Tarrant, Rockwall)
 Judicial races: (Texas Supreme Court, Court of Criminal Appeals, Court of Appeals, District Courts, County Courts, Justice of the Peace Courts)
 Bonds and Props: There are several bonds and propositions on ballots; they're broken down here by schools, municipalities and counties .
 Previous results: Here are the results from the March primary and runoff .
 Dallas County will open 84 polling locations for early voting in the Nov. 3 midterm election.
 Watch NBC 5 free wherever you are
   WATCH HERE 
 Early voting runs from Oct. 19 through Oct. 30, with hours varying by day. In Dallas County, from Monday, Oct. 19 through Saturday, Oct. 24, polling centers will be open from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. On Sunday, Oct. 25, polling centers will be open from noon to 6 p.m. From Monday, Oct. 26 through Friday, Oct. 30, polling centers will be open from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.
 If you are in line when the polls close, you'll be allowed to vote.
